visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young people (two women, one man) stand at a Hong Kong airport exit, excitedly holding their smartphones. One woman wears a white shirt, the other a blue layered top, and the man a black polo over a white collar. They are smiling broadly in a bright, modern airport terminal with blue patterned carpeting. (2) A close-up graphic of a smartphone screen appears, showing an 'eSIM' setting interface in Traditional Chinese, demonstrating how to enable data roaming. (3) The scene shifts to the interior of a POP MART store. The man holds his phone up to check product information while standing in front of shelves filled with designer toys like 'Molly' and 'Skullpanda'. (4) The woman in the blue top is then shown in a Disney Store, taking a selfie with a large pink plush toy ('LinaBell'). The store is brightly lit with warm shelves full of character merchandise. (5) The woman in the white shirt visits 'HOMELESS', a lifestyle shop, showing off quirky home decor items like a cat-themed jewelry stand. (6) The three creators reunite in the large airport arrival hall with their suitcases, holding up a colorful 'Cool Card' (酷遊卡) credit-card-sized packet. (7) A split-screen montage shows the woman in the blue top at a 7-ELEVEN store using a self-service kiosk to enter a discount code 'three95' for the eSIM service. (8) The video concludes with the trio giving thumbs-up and cheering in front of the camera, with brand logos for 7-ELEVEN, FamilyMart, and Hi-Life appearing at the bottom.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-tempo, bright synth-pop music starts. A female voice speaks excitedly with high arousal, greeting the audience in Traditional Chinese about arriving in Hong Kong. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX marks the switch to a second female voice, who discusses checking roaming settings on her phone with a helpful, friendly tone. (3) A 'pop' SFX accompanies the scene transition. A male voice narrates with exaggerated, comedic energy, describing his shopping at Pop Mart; the music rhythm matches his fast speech rate. (4) A bell-like 'ding' SFX highlights a discount code shown on screen. The second female voice returns, articulating clearly and professionally about purchasing the card at convenience stores. (5) All three voices overlap briefly at the end, chanting a promotional slogan with high volume and joyful intensity as the music crescendos.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Showcase of Airport Shops -> Product Value Proposition (Internet Speed) -> Purchase Tutorial -> Discount Code Reveal -> Final Recommendation.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the 'aircool SIM' (Cool Card) service by showing how three travelers successfully used it to shop and share moments immediately upon arrival at Hong Kong Airport.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of the product (physical SIM/eSIM card), mention of a discount code ('three95'), and call-to-action to purchase at specified convenience stores.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-energy 'TikTok-style' edit with dense text overlays and sound effects to maintain viewer engagement while providing a tutorial for a travel product.
